## [18.2.1](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/compare/v18.2.0...v18.2.1) (2026-11-16)


### Bug Fixes

* **cli:** wait for stdout before exiting ([#4197](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4197)) ([b535046](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/b535046bf59cbe488be4354f02d56b1a1bb6fdaa))
* continue a block quote paragraph with a lazy line that starts an html tag ([#4202](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4202)) ([8a578e4](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/8a578e4c0c7e1c650a6bad82254d30b0d377c730))
* end a block quote at a lazy line after an empty list item ([#4178](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4178)) ([e2f77b4](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/e2f77b4b72ccaefeb99fc74df2bfd7016636c3b2))
* end a list item before a lazy line after an empty or non-paragraph nested block ([#4183](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4183)) ([ac2256e](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/ac2256e1130957341831a8308f73720ede7e6095))
* Fix bracket escapes inside code spans in link text being stripped ([#4205](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4205)) ([9a26ae9](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/9a26ae9ceeb26f79f35a03ec910f996147087ef8)), closes [#4176](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4176) [#4176](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4176) [#4176](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4176)
* keep a tab after the block quote marker's space literal ([#4208](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4208)) ([2d3b47f](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/2d3b47fa217a06f9a360d86ebf0f766d19949621))
* keep rejected table candidates in the preceding paragraph ([#4218](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4218)) ([1c5969e](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/1c5969e395905fa3f33f3a847d8ad655f1dfcce7))
* keep tabs that are code content under a block quote ([#4217](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4217)) ([d2c6f73](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/d2c6f736f339b4739a16426c681528ca210a6e87)), closes [#4184](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4184)
* let a mid-run opener close against a delimiter that can also open ([#4203](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4203)) ([06e1d10](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/06e1d1090338b76c3d458a26d52ee67f72c8d6e1))
* let an autolink or inline html line start or continue a setext heading ([#4191](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4191)) ([72d0fec](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/72d0fec9b59a12c5446b9377cf4363a2794ce54b))
* parse links generated by inline tokenizers ([#4204](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4204)) ([0460f98](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/0460f98b7e2a1dfedf40eccddaa8d8ada1731d2a))
* preserve trailing blank lines in fenced code ([#4200](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4200)) ([7499eb3](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/7499eb3a23eb29c0e9d2ffde551b92439a9b3af6))
* reject a link destination in angle brackets with an unescaped < or > ([#4206](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4206)) ([de71210](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/de71210d4204745b326d2e8357240f7a350221f8))
* remove a task item's checkbox marker from its own text ([#4215](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4215)) ([5902442](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/59024421a4ce874168d3f551565f4ebad121f5af))
* **types:** preserve custom output types in tokenizer overrides ([#4214](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/issues/4214)) ([5e35708](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/commit/5e35708f3f4a88d477c37c2d42ad86907d6b4daf))

# Marked [![npm](https://badgen.net/npm/v/marked)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked) [![install size](https://badgen.net/packagephobia/install/marked)](https://packagephobia.now.sh/result?p=marked) [![downloads](https://badgen.net/npm/dt/marked)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/marked) [![github actions](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/workflows/Tests/badge.svg)](https://github.com/markedjs/marked/actions) [![snyk](https://snyk.io/test/npm/marked/badge.svg)](https://snyk.io/test/npm/marked) [![inspect.software](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/inspect-software/badges/main/v1/m/markedjs/marked.svg)](https://inspect.software/software/markedjs/marked) - ⚡ built for speed - ⬇️ low-level compiler for parsing markdown without caching or blocking for long periods of time - ⚖️ light-weight while implementing all markdown features from the supported flavors & specifications - 🛠️ easily adaptable with [custom extensions](https://marked.js.org/using_advanced#extensions) - 🌐 works in a browser, on a server, or from a command line interface (CLI) ## Demo Check out the [demo page](https://marked.js.org/demo/) to see Marked in action ⛹️ ## Docs Our [documentation pages](https://marked.js.org) are also rendered using marked 💯 Also read about: * [Options](https://marked.js.org/using_advanced) * [Extensibility](https://marked.js.org/using_pro) ## Compatibility **Node.js:** Only [current and LTS](https://nodejs.org/en/about/releases/) Node.js versions are supported. End of life Node.js versions may become incompatible with Marked at any point in time. **Browser:** [Baseline Widely Available](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Baseline/Compatibility) ## Installation **CLI:** ```sh npm install -g marked ``` **In-browser:** ```sh npm install marked ``` ## Usage ### Warning: 🚨 Marked does not [sanitize](https://marked.js.org/using_advanced#options) the output HTML. Please use a sanitize library, like [DOMPurify](https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify) (recommended), [sanitize-html](https://github.com/apostrophecms/sanitize-html) or [insane](https://github.com/bevacqua/insane) on the *output* HTML! 🚨 ``` DOMPurify.sanitize(marked.parse(``)); ``` **CLI** ``` bash # Example with stdin input $ marked -o hello.html hello world ^D $ cat hello.html

hello world
